item.description:
# Do It Then 0.1.6
- Show Reminder notes and make links directly clickable in task rows. - Refresh timed event cards and calendar drop destinations. - Make calendar dragging visually continuous with stable lifted previews and preserved grab offset. - Make repeated cross-day edge navigation symmetric and cancel invalid edge releases back to the original day. - Allow existing calendar events to move into past dates with the normal outlined drop preview. - Refine primary-action contrast and scheduling-duration safeguards.
